falsifier_requirement.trigger: FAOSTAT or WOAH snapshot hash is missing or changes during replay; heldout livestock or disease values leak into formula selection; N is below 20; carry-forward or rolling-mean comparator ties or beats the model within uncertainty; country/year disease shuffle is not rejected

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: y_hat(country, item, year) = training-only lagged livestock level + rolling growth trend + predeclared disease-burden lag adjustment where WOAH source rows are locked

incumbent_comparator_requirement.baseline_name: FAOSTAT carry-forward and rolling-mean livestock baseline
incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: predict heldout livestock/health target with last observation carried forward and trailing five-year mean on the same official source snapshot
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Inspect the existing scorer output, repair the OC model/comparator/residual/materiality implementation, and preserve negative results if OC does not beat the comparator.

required_source_block.source_authority: WOAH World Animal Health Information System
required_source_block.source_name: WOAH World Animal Health Information System

residual_requirement.formula: absolute residual for count/production rows; aggregate scaled MAE by country/species/year
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: model_scaled_MAE + uncertainty_margin < comparator_scaled_MAE and disease-label controls are rejected

target_variable.extraction_rule: Target values remain hidden until scoring according to the domain-local work order.
target_variable.name: heldout_country_year_livestock_production_and_notifiable_disease_burden
target_variable.unit: FAOSTAT livestock head/count or production quantity; WOAH outbreak/event count

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute residual for count/production rows; aggregate scaled MAE by country/species/year
uncertainty_requirement.rule: rolling-origin residual envelope by species and country before target unsealing

why_it_failed: The domain scorer ran, but the OC model/comparator/materiality predicates remain fail-closed.
